pr_title: Move kubeadm integration tests to test/integration/kubeadm
pr_body:
Refactor to make kubeadm integration tests follow standard integration test pattern
- Moved kubeadm tests to test/integration/kubeadm directory
- Removed special case handling of kubeadm from hack/make-rules/test-cmd.sh
- Remove cmd/kubeadm/test/** exclusion from hack/make-rules/test.sh
- Build kubeadm and set KUBEADM_PATH in hack/make-rules/test-integration.sh so kubeadm integration tests can run
- Separated unit-test-specific util functions from integration-test-specific util functions

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
kubeadm tests in cmd/kubeadm/test are not true integration tests, and this causes a couple of issues.
1. Makes it difficult to use `go test ./...` in some cases because it tries to run these tests
2. Special code exists for kubeadm to exclude or include these tests for `make test` and `make test-integration`

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #91740 

**Special notes for your reviewer**:
This improves the usage of `go test ./...`, and fixes the problem as it pertains to kubeadm. **But using `go test ./...` from the project root *still* does not work because it will try to run the tests contained within test/e2e and test/integration**... it just tries to run everything it can find.

However, I think this is still a worthwhile refactor as it eliminates the need to handle kubeadm differently than every other part of the system when it comes to running unit and integration tests.

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
NONE
```

```

issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/

**What happened**:
When I do `go test ./...` from the kubernetes root, it fails because the tests in [cmd/kubeadm/test](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/cmd/kubeadm/test) have external dependencies.  KUBEADM_PATH is required for example.
```

**What you expected to happen**:
The [Kubernetes Testing Guide](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-testing/testing.md#run-all-unit-tests) says I should be able to run all unit tests using `go test ./...`

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:
Clone the repository and run `go test ./...` from the project root.

Or, you can more quickly see the problem if you rjust un that from the cmd/kubeadm subfolder like this:
```
cd cmd/kubeadm
go test ./...
```

**Anything else we need to know?**:
`make test` [specifically excludes cmd/kubeadm/test](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/b48f5af2602bf097c11c6a252bc7f82a7c096206/hack/make-rules/test.sh#L43) so that the problem does not occur if you use make test.

When this issue is fixed, we should probably remove this exclusion as well.

/sig cluster-lifecycle
/area kubeadm
hello, i'm having deja-vu on this topic but i may have discussed it with someone else and not you @brianpursley ?

this will not work.
```
cd cmd/kubeadm
go test ./...
```

you have to do:
```
cd cmd/kubeadm/app
go test ./...
```

as you may have figured out, `cmd/kubeadm/test` contains integration tests that should not be run run without the required env vars.

> panic: the environment variable KUBEADM_PATH must point to the kubeadm binary path
> [recovered]
>	panic: the environment variable KUBEADM_PATH must point to the kubeadm binary path

this should not be fixed, as the integration test needs a binary.
also we should not move the kubeadm integration tests to another location.

i don't think we should take any action here. also kubeadm is moving out of k/k at some point in the (near) future.

/priority awaiting-more-evidence
I would expect go tests outside the test/integration and test/e2e packages to be unit tests, and to be able to run `go test ./cmd/...`
/sig testing
@neolit123 I think we did probably discuss in slack.

I opened an issue to remove that from the docs, but the question was raised why don't we just fix the problem since it just seems to be this one subdirectory that is the problem.

Can these tests be moved to the integration folder and if so would that fix the issue?

this has been the case for while now (possibly 10+ releases) at least, but if sig-testing and others are fine with this we can extract the `./cmd/kubeadm/test` to somewhere in `/test/integration/`.

PRs welcome too, please.
I would also accept skipping the tests if KUBEADM_PATH is unset rather than panicing
> PRs welcome too, please.

I'll take it and see what I can come up with...

/assign
@neolit123 @liggitt Here is a PR to move the kubeadm integration tests to the test/integration/kubeadm directory: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/91826

I think it is a good change because it eliminates some of the special-case handling of kubeadm tests and extracts some of the integration test util functions that got inter-mixed with unit test util functions.

... But...
it wasn't everything I hoped it would be because it still does not allow `go test ./...` to work from the kubernetes root.

`go test ./...` from the root tries to run things in the /test directory.  I just don't think that is a feasible way to run tests, at least not from the root. From a subdirectory it will probably work though.

i've added a couple of comments on the PR. thank you for taking on this.
unclear whether splitting kubeadm source code in two locations is a good idea for the sake of better supporting `go test ...` calls.

> it wasn't everything I hoped it would be because it still does not allow go test ./... to work from the kubernetes root.

i don't think `go test ./...` is an achievable goal or something we should push for.
claiming support for `go test ./cmd/...` makes more sense.
Yeah, I'm starting to think @liggitt 's suggestion of just checking KUBEADM_PATH and skipping might be the best next move with least impact...
Or just leaving it how it is too, and maybe just update the docs like the original idea.
> Yeah, I'm starting to think liggitt 's suggestion of just checking KUBEADM_PATH and skipping might be the best next move with least impact...

i think it used to be like that but i may have broken it with a recent cleanup.

skipping tests in cmd/kubeadm/test if KUBEADM_PATH is not defined is messy, but arguably better than moving cmd/kubeadm/test to another location.
I'm thinking just update the docs to say don't use `go test ./...` from the repository root. 
Besides, there are a number of reasons that won't work, and kubeadm is just one of them.

Also, the more I think about it, I don't really like the idea of conditionally skipping the tests because it could result in the tests being mistakenly skipped when they are supposed to be run... for example, if someday in the future, the integration tests are modified and accidentally unset KUBEADM_PATH, the tests would just stop running (instead of failing) and we wouldn't really know about it unless someone looked closely and noticed they were being skipped.

I'll go ahead and close this issue.  Thanks for talking it through with me and reviewing the PR. I don't mean to waste your time, but it has been valuable to me from a learning standpoint at least.
Ack. Thank you for taking the time to look at this.

review_comments:
so the introduction of cmd/kubeadm/app/testing is something good and i forgot about this problem where kubeadm imports it's integration tests for some utils.
i wasn't around to gate such a change, so it slipped trough in multiple packages...

so by moving such utils under /app, /app no longer has to import /test which is good.
